stop: no new accepted window or invalid affine
fit: accepted centre positions only; normalized weighted least squares, 10 Huber iterations cutoff max(1 px,2.5 median residual)
rectification: J(z)=original_target(A z+t), bilinear uint8; original sampled each round, no chained image resampling
selection: existing sparse verification and native-coordinate confirmation; thresholds unchanged
native_validation: all new rectified states resolved on original image before acceptance
runtime: WGSL solves; host affine fit and rectification; experimental, not GPU resident
followup: After fixed five-level pilot, evaluate same frozen protocol on all 191 targets; no threshold changes
